items.headline: Planet Fitness Q2 CY2026 revenue $365.2M, up 7.1%, tops estimates; adj EPS $0.88 beats by 3.7%
items.summary: Brand momentum holds, but system-wide same-club sales grew only 1.7% and adjusted net income fell 5.7% — watch the comp line.

items.headline: Planet Fitness appoints Sudhanshu Priyadarshi CFO and President, International
items.summary: New international leadership is the counterparty for Bravo Fit's development pipeline — worth an early relationship.

items.headline: Franchise Equity Partners acquires Bravo Fit, Planet Fitness' Australian franchisee
items.summary: 32 clubs today with exclusive development rights for ~100 more across VIC, NSW, SA, QLD and ACT; targeting 135+ clubs.
